dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.1:1 ratio of maximum base width to maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 145 degrees at the junction of the melon and rostrum.
